facing: Blender -Y = glTF +Z: in Godot the model faces +Z (use look_at(target, Vector3.UP, true) or rotate 180 deg)

clips.name: slam
clips.notes: both fists hit the ground ~1.45 m in front (Godot +Z), x = +/-0.36

clips.name: swipe
clips.notes: right-arm horizontal sweep from its right to its left at chest height, reach ~1.6 m

clips.name: charge_stun
clips.notes: starts from the charge pose; staggers ~0.4 m back in place and returns

clips.name: death
clips.notes: falls to its knees, then forward onto its face; last frame holds

weak_spot.notes: magenta crystal cluster on the upper back (2x damage); a sphere ~0.45 m radius centred ~0.25 m along the back_crystal bone covers it

notes: In-place animations; move it at ground_speed_mps during walk/charge. Loop idle, walk and charge in code (Godot imports them non-looping).
slam: 0.9 s telegraph (arms raised high), fists hit at 1.0 s ~1.45 m in front.
charge_start ends exactly on charge frame 0; charge_stun starts from that pose.
Material 'Armor' = fused station plating; 'EmitBack' = weak-point crystals (also two small crystal 'eyes').
death: last frame holds (lying face down).
